name: 执勤反光雨衣
description: A long navy rain poncho with a hood and a yellow-green reflective band across the chest; two pixels of water dripping from the hem.

name: 拳馆练功服
description: A white front-opening kung-fu jacket with a row of knot buttons and a wide black sash.

name: 染血白工装
prototype: no photo: white butcher's overalls with a rubber apron
description: White coveralls with a rubber apron, a large rust-red stain on the chest (flat colour, not gore).

name: 拾荒者伪装衫
description: A patched ragged jacket, its collar turned open to show the corner of a black armour plate inside.

name: 香主绸衫
description: A dark-grey long gown with a standing collar and knot buttons, its cuffs turned back to show dark-red lining, with a faint glassy sheen on the silk.

name: 防爆重甲
description: A full hard-shell riot / bomb suit, heavy class: big chest plate, shoulder guards, high neck guard, gray-green, a dent across the front. It must not look like 特别督察组战术护甲 (navy) or 复合护具 (cluttered).

name: 推土肩甲
description: One oversized round iron shoulder plate with a ring of rivets and a leather strap crossing the chest; heavy class. Asymmetric on purpose.

name: 督察组外勤背心
description: A lighter field vest of the inspection squad: navy and charcoal, soft, with the set's vermilion ID band across the left chest.

name: 灰尾长衫
description: A dark-grey long gown with dark-red lining, standing collar and pale-violet glass buttons. It must differ from 香主绸衫 by the glass buttons and a darker, plainer cut.

name: 执勤警哨
description: A silver whistle on a short black cord with a small metal clip.

name: 防风打火机
description: A square flip-top lighter, lid open, with a 2-pixel orange flame (emit).

name: 老千骰子
description: Two bone-white dice stacked; one shows the single red pip on top.

name: 跌打药酒瓶
prototype: no photo: a flat round glass medicine bottle
description: A flat round glass bottle of brown liniment with a red cloth stopper.

name: 无人机遥控器
prototype: no photo: a small twin-stick RC transmitter
description: A small twin-stick remote with a short antenna and a screen with one green pixel lit (emit).

name: 当铺铜牌
prototype: no photo: a brass pawn tag
description: A rectangular brass tag pierced at one end with a cord, a single round motif on its face (no characters).

name: 琉璃护身珠
description: A string of five translucent glass beads, the middle one large, pale-violet inner glow (emit).

name: 快拳绑带
description: A roll of grey-white hand wrap with dark red soaking through one end.

name: 组长臂章
description: A white Reunion armband with a red stripe on a safety-pin clasp. No Reunion symbol, just the stripe.

name: 灰尾屏障坠
description: A hexagonal glass plate, cracked, glowing blue-white in the cracks (emit).

name: 燃烧瓶挂包
description: A canvas satchel with the neck of a rag-stuffed glass bottle sticking out.

name: 督察组任期铭牌
description: Two stainless tags stacked on a short chain, no text, with a vermilion band on the chain.

name: 碎琉璃坠
description: Half of a broken glass pendant, pale violet with an inner glow (emit), the break edge sharp and bright.
